Welcome to ViruSweep!

Key Features:

🛡️ Security
► Virus Scan: Scan and remove viruses.

🧹 Storage Cleaner
► Junk Cleaner: Clean junk files.
► Large File Cleaner: Identify and remove large files you no longer need.
► Media Manager: Easily find and delete your pictures, videos, and audio files in one simple interface.
► Duplicate Photo Finder: Find and remove similar photos to clean your gallery and save space.
► Image Compressor: Reduce the size of your photos.
► App Manager: Get a view of all your installed apps. Easily uninstall unwanted applications.

We're here to help! Reach out to us with your feedback or issues at: tundebalo090@gmail.com
